A {#mImAMsA#} rule of interpretation according
 to which an expression is to be considered as a {#nAmaDeya#} (name of
 a {#yAga#}) if in the sequel is found a statement comparing the {#yAga#}
 with the idea or thing expressed by that term. This rule is discussed
 by {#jEmini#} and {#Sabara#} at <ls>MS. 1. 4. 5</ls>.
